Environment

Configured via environment variables — changing these requires restarting the server.

Server

VariableCurrentDefaultDescription
DATABASE_URLsqlite:///tmp/p.sqlite3?mode=rwcsqlite://pingward.sqlite3?mode=rwcThe database connection string (SQLite or Postgres).
PINGWARD_BIND0.0.0.0:8080127.0.0.1:8080The socket address the server listens on.
PINGWARD_BASE_URLhttp://localhost:18080http://localhost:8080Used to render absolute ping URLs.
PINGWARD_LOG_FORMATfullfullLog line format (full, compact, pretty or json); applied at process startup — changing it requires a restart.
PINGWARD_HSTS_MAX_AGE00 (off)Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds; 0 sends no header. Prefer setting this on the reverse proxy — see README.

Scheduling

VariableCurrentDefaultDescription
PINGWARD_SCAN_INTERVAL3030Fallback scan interval — only used when no check, project, or global setting overrides it (check → project → global setting → env cascade).
PINGWARD_PRUNE_INTERVAL_SECS36003600How often old pings/notifications are deleted.

Auth

VariableCurrentDefaultDescription
PINGWARD_FORWARD_AUTH_HEADERnot set(unset)Header name for the trusted-proxy forward-auth mechanism.
PINGWARD_TRUSTED_PROXIESnot set(unset)Proxy addresses trusted to set the forward-auth header.
PINGWARD_FORWARD_AUTH_LOGOUT_URLnot set(unset)Where logging out sends the browser — point it at the gateway's sign-out endpoint to end the SSO session too. Unset means /login.
PINGWARD_COOKIE_SECUREfalsederived from PINGWARD_BASE_URL's schemeWhether the session cookie carries `Secure`. Leave unset unless TLS terminates upstream and PINGWARD_BASE_URL cannot say so.

Email (SMTP)

VariableCurrentDefaultDescription
PINGWARD_SMTP_HOSTsmtp.invalid(unset)Instance SMTP server host.
PINGWARD_SMTP_PORT587(unset)Instance SMTP server port.
PINGWARD_SMTP_FROMpingward@example.com(unset)The From address used for outgoing email notifications.
PINGWARD_SMTP_TLSstarttls(unset)SMTP transport security mode (starttls, tls, or none).
PINGWARD_SMTP_USERNAMEnot set(unset)SMTP AUTH username (an identity, not a credential — shown verbatim).
PINGWARD_SMTP_PASSWORDnot set(unset)SMTP AUTH password — never displayed, only whether it's configured.
